g.text: JRC BioSAMs, value added (current US$, symlog scale)
FABIO-v2 value-added extension, COMBINED-GLORIA (current US$, symlog scale)

One point per country x year x item, components summed cell. The extension's FABIO-item value added is aggregated up to BioSAM categories. Both axes symlog: linear within ±US$1 and logarithmic beyond, so the linear core and every decade outside it are equally wide and the panels share a scale. Dashed line = identity; grey lines mark zero, so sign disagreement reads off the off-diagonal quadrants. Taxes less subsidies is the production-side measure on both sides. 132 of 1781 cells withheld: one side is zero with no primary observation behind it (66 extension-side, 66 reference-side).
COMBINED-GLORIA extension vs JRC BioSAMs at L3
